emma: Heads up — CI surfaced a longseq quant perf regression hitting runtime v3.2.1 in eu-west. I propose a regional soft-pin to v3.1.4 for the next ~6h while we triage. Opinions?
raj: Saw the same on canary this morning. p99 up ~15% and a couple OOMs on 32k seq runs. soft-pin sounds reasonable.
olivia: Can deploybot do region-only pins? don't want to affect us-east.
marco: yes, deploybot supports regional scopes. sample command: `deploybot pin runtime --region eu-west --version v3.1.4 --until 2026-03-20T16:00Z --reason "longseq regression"`
emma: Plan: 1) soft-pin runtime -> v3.1.4 in eu-west only 2) attach monitor for p99, error-rate, kv-cache miss 3) 30m evaluation window; if metrics improve keep; else rollback and route traffic to fallback model group + open incident.
raj: Rollback criteria proposal: if p99 doesn't drop by at least 10% in 30m OR error-rate increases >0.5% absolute => unpin and trigger fallback. If pin helps, we can extend but need approvals.
sre-oncall: I'll add Datadog monitors now: `avg(last_5m):p99_latency{region:eu-west,service:runtime} > 200` and `increase(errors, 5m) > 0.005`. Alerts wired to #ops-incidents pager. tagging @jen for runbook edits.
deploy-bot: Automated: scheduled pin request received from emma at 2026-03-20T09:05Z — runtime v3.1.4 pinned in eu-west until 2026-03-20T16:00Z. Pin ID: PB-5520001111.
jen: Please update the release_notes.md with the soft-pin rationale and the temporary rollback criteria. Also add a short blurb under "regional mitigations" in the runbook.
marco: Also recommend toggling kv prefetch to false on the pinned pool to rule out cache pressure: `cache.kv_prefetch=false` — low-risk toggle.
emma: I'll apply the cache toggle after 10m and run the telemetry script. Posting the quick checklist: `1) Deploy pin -> PB-5520001111 2) Attach monitors 3) Apply cache toggle 4) Monitor 30m 5) Decide extend/rollback`
raj: Watching canaries now. Will post metrics snapshots in ~15m.
olivia: LGTM. please ping before any extension beyond 6h.
deploy-bot: Automated: monitor policy attached to PB-5520001111 -> alerts -> #ops-incidents.
sre-oncall: Confirmed: pager policy live and escalation set. If we hit the threshold, I'll page and post proposed rollback steps here.
emma: Locking this in. If we need emergency rollback we'll use the rollback playbook and post status updates in this thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
jen: Added changelog entry and runbook section.
sre-oncall: 5520003399: Pager integration tested and active.
